create_pose_encoding: create a pose encoding from camera extrinsics and intrinsics tensors with image size
convert_pose_encoding_to_extrinsics: convert a pose encoding tensor back to camera extrinsics and intrinsics matrices
encode_camera_pose_absT_quaR_FoV: encode camera pose using absolute translation, quaternion rotation, and field of view
decode_camera_pose_absT_quaR_FoV: decode camera pose from absT_quaR_FoV encoding back to extrinsics and intrinsics
build_intrinsics_from_fov: build camera intrinsics matrix from field of view values and image dimensions
